description:
Must possess 1 year of Informatica experience with demonstrated, hands-on development using Informatica tool version 9.x. 
 Experience analyzing user and source system requirements and providing efficient design solutions
 Ability to understand business processes and translate business requirements into Informatica code
 Experience designing, administering and maintaining/troubleshooting ETL workflows in a Development and Production environment
 MicroStrategy experience, ability to understand and construct SQL queries, and experience working in CMS data warehousing environment a plus

 

 If you are interested please share your resume to mohammedm @usmsystems(dot)com or you can call me directly on 703-880-2641.
